provenance.overlay_recipe:
# Run from the repository root of a revision containing this fixture; source_sha records the upstream seam revision.
# The digest below verifies that the local upstream source matches that revision. All artifacts stay in .uzi/scratch.
python3 - <<'REGENERATE'
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
fixture = json.loads((root / 'agent/test/fixtures/2393-review-snapshot.json').read_text())
source_path = root / 'api/internal/workersvc/review_authors_test.go'
assert hashlib.sha256(source_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == fixture['provenance']['source_file_sha256'], 'upstream source differs from source_sha'
source = source_path.read_text()
source = source.replace('"fmt"\n', '"fmt"\n\t"os"\n', 1)
copy = root / '.uzi/scratch/2393-review_authors_test.go'
copy.write_text(source + fixture['provenance']['generator_source'])
(root / '.uzi/scratch/2393-overlay.json').write_text(json.dumps({'Replace': {str(root / 'api/internal/workersvc/review_authors_test.go'): str(copy)}}, indent=2) + '\n')
REGENERATE
cd api
scratch=../.uzi/scratch
log=$(mktemp "${scratch:?}/gate-log.XXXXXX")
rc=0
GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false go test -overlay ../.uzi/scratch/2393-overlay.json ./internal/workersvc -run '^TestGenerate2393ReviewSnapshots$' -count=1 -v > "$log" 2>&1 || rc=$?
echo "EXIT=$rc" >> "$log"
printf 'LOG=%s\n' "$log"
test "$rc" -eq 0
# Read the printed log, then compare .uzi/scratch/2393-generated-snapshots.json
# with the fixture's mixed and all_withheld fields. ordinary_empty is synthetic.
